To your left, a group of patrons huddles around a flickering candle, animatedly discussing recent civil events in Emberfall. Across the room, a bard strikes a melancholic chord on a lute, adding a layer of bittersweet to the evening's air. Hester stands prominent at the bar, her fingers gripping the locket as if steadying herself amid the chaos.

You note a few items scattered on the bar top—an empty glass, a half-eaten loaf of bread, and a small, ornate key that shimmers oddly in the tavern light. The scent of spices and baked goods swirls around you, creating an inviting atmosphere, yet your instincts remain sharp, awareness alive to any latent tension beneath the surface.
